answers.label: Comments on opposition to QC4
answers.text: ASEAN is in the midst of developing a connected grid but full integration would likely be in 20 years' time. Hourly contractual instruments are not yet available and would present challenges for the region.

Enhances comparability across reporters and frameworks using GHG Protocol data
